$comment: Hand-authored grouping of the grammar's node types for the Grammars tab. Guarded by dev/scripts/grammar-groups-check.py in nix flake check and by the page's runtime check. Type names are grammar TAGs (REQUIREMENT), never UID prefixes. A group's widget is "cards" (types: a list of TAGs, or the string "rest" for every TAG not placed elsewhere, at most once) or "grid" (axes: two lists of two words, cells: one TAG per [row, column] pair). The Definition axis words are DEC-NODE-FAMILIES' own: normative/descriptive, universal/particular.
